description: This file defines the 'ArticleUnit' result class for a database schema using Moose and DBIx::Class. It specifies the table name, columns, primary key, relationships to other tables (articles, units, dish ingredients, items, recipe ingredients), and makes the class immutable.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::ArticleUnit
classes.description: A class representing the association between articles and units, including relationships to articles, units, dish ingredients, items, and recipe ingredients.

methods.name: add_columns

methods.name: set_primary_key
methods.description: Sets the composite primary key on 'article_id' and 'unit_id'.

methods.name: belongs_to
methods.description: Defines foreign key relationships to 'Article' and 'Unit' tables.

methods.name: has_many
methods.description: Defines one-to-many relationships to 'DishIngredient', 'Item', and 'RecipeIngredient' tables.
